00-aujourdhui: Today, we're learning the letter q.
02-regarde: Watch how we write the q.
03-depart: We start on the green dot. We make a round: we turn to the LEFT, we go round the bottom, and we come back up to the green dot. Then we LIFT the pencil. We go a little higher, and we draw a line straight DOWN, below the line. We lift the pencil again. And from the green dot, we come down gently in a curve, until we touch the line.
04-encore: One more time, a little faster.
05-cherchons: The q never goes out on its own: it always takes a u with it. Let's find words that begin with q u.
10-pareil: Did you hear? They all begin the same way.
11-relance: Find a word that begins with q u.
